steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Spray two large pieces of aluminum foil with cooking spray.

Place salmon fillet on top of one piece of foil. Sprinkle salmon with salt, pepper, garlic, and chopped dill. Arrange lemon slices on top of the fillet and place a sprig of dill on top of each slice. Sprinkle fillet with chopped scallions.
Cover salmon with the second piece of foil and pinch together the foil to seal tightly. Place on a baking sheet or in a large baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes until salmon flakes easily.

raw_recipe.headline: Garlic Salmon
raw_recipe.description: A large salmon fillet, steamed in foil and cooked either in the oven or barbecue. It's seasoned with minced garlic, fresh baby dill, lemon slices, fresh ground pepper, and green onions.
raw_recipe.name: Garlic Salmon

review.reviewBody: I use this recipe with a little twist. I mix the minced garlic/dill/lemon juice with soft butter. Then drop balls of the butter mixture with onions on the salmon & cook in foil in the oven or BarBQ. I always receive compliments on how moist & tasty the salmon turns out. Try it you'll love it!!

FINALLY! EUREKA! PRAISE THE LORD! OK, that being said.....I have never and I mean never-ever cooked a decent piece of salmon for hubby. THIS WAS IT! WA-LA.....so simple. BUT, I followed another reviewers suggestion and mixed soft butter w/dill and garlic and brushed lemon juice over it (not TO much) gave it the sea salt and fresh cracked pepper treatment and wrapped in foil and cooked in a HOT oven (450) for 6-7 min. for a "thinner" piece. Hubby ate the whole piece......head no longer hung in shame here. THANK YOU for this recipe......needless to say: IT's a KEEPER!

Recipe was such a delicious treat. The only thing I added to recipe was fresh minced ginger other then that I stuck to recipe. I had a 6 oz filet baked at 350 for 17 mins along with garlic brussel sprouts drizzled with soy sauce and chopped Fuji apples ... I baked them all together

OMG this was great.... I used dried dill weed not fresh. I added two pats of butter on top of each piece of salmon and lowered the temp to 425. It was done and I let it rest without opening the foil about 10 minutes. Perfect and moist!!!
Made per recipe with sockeye salmon, and steamed in foil for 15 min. at 400 degrees, then opened foil and cooked under broiler for 5 min. Outstanding!

I did as the first reviewer and mixed lemon juice, dill, and garlic into some softened butter and spread that on the salmon. Then I topped with the lemon slices and dill. My salmon was super thick so the flavor was pretty subtle, but this cooking method produced the moistest salmon I've ever made (I can't stand dry or overcooked fish, cooking long depletes the fish of its wonderful flavor!). Again, my salmon was super thick and I only cooked it for the 20 minutes...it was done to perfection!

Very tasty recipe. I prepared the salmon as directed (with perhaps a bit more garlic and dill than called for). I placed it on the grill at a low temperature for about 25-30 mins. The end result was very moist. Will definitely make again!

This is a great recipe. Of course it depends on a few things like your thickness of salmon and your oven. For me, I've made this twice and it was noticeably better with thicker filets - because my oven runs hot I could have easily cooked it for 2-3 minutes less than I did (which was only 18 minutes) when I had thinner filets.
Also, I prefer to use some softened butter and mix in the dill, garlic, and pepper (no extra salt since I had salted butter) and then smear it over the filets, place lemon slices on top and bake wrapped in foil. I've made salmon a few other ways and this is almost foolproof! My fiance and I love it so much! It is better with fresh garlic than the squeeze-bottle pre-chopped kind (no surprise, but it is more noticeable here than with other recipes). And it's actually pretty cheap for cooking salmon, which I appreciate too.

I made this recipe for Valentine's Day and I must say that it was a hit! I took away one star only because I followed the change that some other reviewers recommended. I mixed the garlic and chopped dill with 2 tbsp butter and a few splashes of lemon juice. I followed the recipe but just spread that mixture on top of the salmon before the lemon slices and dill sprigs. I cooked it a bit longer than 25 minutes. It was delicious. The seasoning didn't over power the fish.The fish was nice and tender. It was just right.
Delicious I did this recipe like Adrienne twist with mixing the garlic with the butter. I also removed the top foil piece and drizzled honey atop the salmon and cooked for another 5 minutes.

Nice and quick combination of my favorite ingredient., baked it in a small dish and covered with foil. I served it with oven roasted; quartered red potatoes, baby carrots, diced onion, celery and a mix of seasonings tossed in olive oil. baked for a hour then added the garlic salmon for additional 25 min. Oven to table... Delicious! Thank you for the new ideas for salmon, my favorite.
This was very delicious! I added some tomatoes because I had them, otherwise I followed the recipe!! My son and husband loved it!!
Absolutely delicious. Squeezed a bit of fresh lemon on the salmon and served with rice and steamed broccoli with Parmesan!!!
Super yummy and easy. The dill and lemon complement the salmon very well. A great introduction to salmon if you've never had it, or liked it, before.

This was a very simple recipe to an elegant dish. I didn’t have the fresh dill sprigs but did use the dried dill. It came out great the family enjoyed it. Wish I took a pic it looked wonderful. I will be making it again. Pic to come
Delicious !
I replaced the non stick spray with a slice of butter on top, made the salmon super juicy! my picky son loved it!
There was too much garlic, otherwise ok. I didn’t have fresh dill and used dried. Fresh would have helped. Doubt if I’ll try it again.
My boyfriend and I made this for valentine’s day. It turned out wonderfully. We had to adjust the servings for two but was so much better than expected. We will definitely be making this again!!
This was very easy to make and so delicious! We will be making this quite often!
